GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , eventually worked across to lead rails 1000m, headed before the corner but was still held together, let down from the 200m and regained the lead, slipped away again final stages and won with something in hand # dominant late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, shifted around heels Straightening Up and ran up to hit Lead at the 120m, narrowly Headed 75m, kept battling to post. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Passed suitable to race.] # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight. Near the 100m, shifted in and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then buffeted (-2 lengths) and Settled Down 10 Lengths on fence, railed to 7 Lengths turning, Checked home turn and Held Up until taking cutaway and Made Some Ground to the line # very slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and was steadied when buffeted between runners shortly after. Rounding the home turn was checked after improving onto heels. Unable to improve from this point until near the 350m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led by a half length jointly urning, Headed 250m and Dropped Out from there # weak once headed

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then Hooked Out Five Wide Straightening Up and dropped right out in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early/middle stages. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped shortly after the start. Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, ridden along a touch turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, still 1 length clear approaching 100m, kept on strong, holding off late challenge # led/fell in
Jumped Ok , drove Through and led rails 800m, Ridden Along soon after Straightening Up , Headed last 200m and weakened # led/weakened 200m

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3rd on the fence 4 Lengths from the lead, Held Together same to the turn, steered to centre of track Straightening Up , ran on solidly in straight despite being carried wider at 100m and bumped at 50m. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME) # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Carried wider approaching and passing the 100m. Bumped on two occasions over the final 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up , Headed 140m and lost ground to the line # weak once headed
Jumped Ok took sit 1-1 3l 600m 4th 4l Under Pressure 400m Straightened Up 5th weakened final 250m # weak last 250m
Jumped Well pressed on to face breeze half off, ridden along turn, joined in Straightening Up , found little and dropped out # faced breeze

Jumped Fast from a low draw. early Leader then Took A Sit Clear 2nd, 2.5 Lengths @ 1100m. fanned 3 Wide Straightening Up all Clear . had nothing left in Straight at all (vetted - nothing amiss) # poor finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
